content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: For purposes of this Agreement, `Confidential Information` means any proprietary information disclosed by the Disclosing Party that is marked or designated as confidential or that, under the circumstances surrounding its disclosure, ought to be treated as confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall not, directly or indirectly, disclose, use, or permit the use of Confidential Information except as expressly authorized herein or as required by law.
